summary: Consolidate dune modules with uritime routing and bottlenecks fixes

delivery.outcome: Consolidate emllm/dune modules (TaskConfigGenerator, TaskValidator, InteractiveMapper, SmartEnvManager) with uritime BM25-lite lexical routing, canonical distribution/module mapping, semcod/bottlenecks fixes, modular <500-line files, CLI route/config/validate subcommands, and offline tests/benchmarks into emllm/dun.
nonGoals: No unapproved runtime dependencies beyond pyyaml added in ticket-002
No pre-existing untracked docs/README.md or errors/README.md modifications

architecture.decision: Consolidate dune modules cleanly under src/dun/ in <500-line cohesive modules, backed by uritime BM25-lite lexical routing and dun.packages distribution/module normalization, plus CLI route/config/validate subcommands.
interfaceChanges: Export lexical router, config generator, task validator, interactive mapper, env manager, and package resolver from dun.__init__
Add route, config, and validate subcommands to dun.__main__
Wire dun.packages availability checks into DynamicPackageManager and TaskValidator

validation.evidence: All existing 44 baseline tests and new consolidated dune/uritime/bottlenecks unit tests pass with 0 warnings, all src/dun/*.py files remain under 500 lines, offline benchmark achieves target accuracy with 0 duplicate pip installs, and governance-check reports GOV-PASS.
